gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-kannada: Capture It stands towering and urban, its lines held at a fixed pressure with openings nearly sealed shut. Anek Kannada, a lighter sans with squared, woodblock-high letters, gives it room to breathe underneath.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-odia: Sealed-up and sharp, Capture It draws every line like a laser-etched trace, towering above everything. But Anek Odia's rounds stay open like an unlatched hook, which is the whole point of putting it beside Capture It.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil swells its lowercase into generous round bowls, modern and unhurried. Anek Tamil is built for steady reading, while Capture It, flat in weight and nearly sealed, is built to be noticed.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-telugu: Towering and shut tight, Capture It ends every terminal at the width it began. Yet Anek Telugu's wide, lofty bowls and unlatched rounds are what really set this sans-serif apart from its heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anuphan: Urban, blunt and nearly sealed shut: that is Capture It. Anuphan's open curves and clear gaps give those closed, towering letters something light and quiet to rest against right underneath.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-armata: Commanding and nearly sealed, Capture It towers above the text, strokes that never swell or thin. Armata does the opposite job, spacing its characters generously and leaving gaps in its rounded sans-serif glyphs.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-athiti: Sealed, urban, commanding: that is Capture It. Capture It owns the big, towering moment, while Athiti, with its see-through s and high mean line, handles the quieter text.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-atkinson-hyperl: Shut tight and towering, Capture It makes a blunt, urban first impression. But Atkinson Hyperlegible does the opposite, keeping wide-set terminals on its s so every letter stays distinct.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic sets a high x-height guide and a generous opening in its c, a modern, professional sans-serif. Beneath Capture It, long text should flow smoothly without a snag.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-chivo: Approachable and compact, Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the capitals and lets daylight into every curve. And Capture It, towering and nearly sealed above it, gives that openness something dense to push against.
